keep_iron_plates.description:
If enabled, a production recipe for iron plates is kept.
This is meant to improve compatibility with other mods that might still require iron plates. Iron plates will still be removed from all normal (vanilla) game recipes.

replace_iron_in_recipes.description:
Experimental: Try to replace all uses of iron plates in other mods with steel plates.
This will work for all mods that use the regular prototypes database, but not catch any instances where iron plates are used through other means like e.g. code injection.
